internal content. Declared alternate titles can name the same item. For a TV file,

is missing or insufficient, abstain. Do not infer that a file is corrupt or wrong
solely because its filename differs. Do not access any evaluator labels, source
annotations, other cases, or external services. Return exactly one JSON object:
{"decision":"match"} or {"decision":"mismatch"} or {"decision":"abstain"}.
